China in 26: EU-China trade relations

 In this episode of our German-language series “China in 26,” Bernhard Bartsch, Mikko Huotari, and Claudia Wessling discuss only one topic, namely the EU-China trade relations. They analyse the results of the negotiations between EU-Trade commissioner Maroš Šefčovič and his Chinese counterpart Wang Wentao in Beijing, the contents of the Franco-German suggestions to the EU Commission and ways ahead in the trade row with China. By playing this video, you load content from YouTube (a Google LLC service).
